meta_description: Learn about Call My Tailor, Delhi NCR's trusted doorstep tailoring service for custom suits, sherwanis, kurtas, shirts, and more with free home visits.
html:
About Us

We are the group of tailor to provide
You best tailoring experience

Our Story

Our Story

Callmytailor quickly established a doorstep designer tailoring service with premium quality in DELHI and NCR. The concept of the tailor-made classic piece not only fits your body but also enhances your personality as well. We are passionate about providing modern stitching, and classical fitting with fine quality fabric.

Callmytailor provides all kinds of men's wear for weddings, casual, and formal wear like suit, blazer, sherwani, indo-western, jodhpuri, kurta jackets, and pant shirt.

Callmytailor doesn’t use any standard-size pattern. All the garments are crafted with individual’s size preferences so that we develop a relationship that makes our customers feel inspired and confident.

Our Vision

Nowadays there are so many online or ready-made stores that provide ready-made garments by that people are facing so many problems like poor stitching, low-quality fabric, design, and color by which customer has to compromise with their choice. the big issue is that they provide standard sizes. by which people don’t get a perfect fitting.

After considering all these problems we are ready to customize your cloth according to your choice and your body posture which is individually made for you.

Since everyone’s life is so much busy we don’t have time to go to shops because it wastes our precious time in selecting fabrics. So here you can book a home visit and our agent will go to your convinced place and take the order. after that, we will deliver to you within 7 days.

title: FAQs | Custom Tailoring & Home Visit Questions | Call My Tailor
meta_title: FAQs | Custom Tailoring & Home Visit Questions | Call My Tailor
meta_description: Find answers to common questions about custom tailoring, home visits, measurements, delivery, payments, and booking services at Call My Tailor.
html:
About Call My Tailor

  • What is Callmytailor?

    Callmytailor is a premium doorstep tailoring service based in Delhi & NCR, designed to make custom clothing convenient and accessible. We bring professional tailoring services directly to your home, offering personalized garments crafted according to your exact body measurements, style preferences, and occasion needs. Our focus is on delivering perfect fitting, high-quality stitching, and a seamless customer experience.

  • What services do you offer?

    We offer a complete range of tailoring solutions including custom stitching, designer outfit creation, and alteration & repair services. Whether you need a formal suit, wedding attire, casual wear, or adjustments to your existing garments, our skilled tailors ensure precision and quality in every piece.

  • What types of clothing do you specialize in?

    Callmytailor specializes in both men’s and women’s wear, including suits, blazers, sherwanis, Indo-western outfits, Jodhpuri suits, kurta jackets, shirts, trousers, lehengas, dresses, and wedding outfits. Each garment is tailored to match your body structure and personal style, ensuring a unique and elegant look.

  • What makes Callmytailor different from ready-made brands?

    Unlike ready-made clothing that follows standard sizes, we focus on custom tailoring for every individual. This ensures better comfort, improved fitting, and a more refined appearance. Additionally, our doorstep service saves your time, and our attention to fabric quality and stitching detail ensures a premium experience.

Booking And Delivery

  • How can I book a service?

    Booking with Callmytailor is quick and easy. You can:

    • Call or WhatsApp us at 888-2222-900
    • Visit our website: https://callmytailor.com/booking/home.html

    Our team will schedule a home visit at your convenience.

  • What areas do you serve?

    We currently provide our services across Delhi & NCR, covering major residential and commercial areas to ensure easy accessibility for our customers.

  • How long does delivery take?

    Since it is custom clothes it takes some time to make. but we will hardly deliver to you as soon as possible. Generally, we deliver within 7 days. but it may change according to our workload. so keep checking our delivery date before order before order.

  • Do you offer urgent or express delivery?

    Yes, we do offer urgent or express stitching services for customers who need their outfits on a priority basis. This depends on availability and order requirements, so we recommend contacting us directly to confirm timelines.

Payment

  • What payment options are available?

    We offer multiple convenient payment methods, including UPI, bank transfer, online payments, and cash, making it easy for you to complete your transaction securely.

  • Do I need to pay in advance?

    Yes, to confirm your order, we usually require a partial advance payment (typically 50%). This helps us begin the tailoring process and allocate resources for your order.

  • When do I pay the remaining amount?

    The remaining balance can be paid after the garment is ready or at the time of delivery, ensuring transparency and customer satisfaction.

  • Is there any extra charge for home visits?

    Home visit charges may vary depending on the location and type of service. In many cases, the visit is complimentary or adjusted in your final order value, making the experience convenient and cost-effective.

How to Choose Fabrics? A Complete Guide by Call My Tailor

Posted by: Chandan Created Date: 09 Jun 0 Comments

Choosing the right fabric is one of the most important decisions when designing custom clothing. Whether you're having a suit, blazer, shirt, kurta pajama, or wedding outfit made, the fabric determines how the item looks, feels, fits, and lasts.

Many people focus only on color and design, but experienced tailors know that fabric is the foundation of every great outfit. The correct cloth boosts comfort, durability, attractiveness, and confidence.

In this article, we'll teach you how to select the ideal fabric for each event. 

Why Is Fabric Selection So Important?

The fabric you choose affects:

  • Comfort and breathability

  • Overall appearance

  • Durability and lifespan

  • Wrinkle resistance

  • Seasonal suitability

  • Garment drape and fit

Even the best design cannot achieve its full potential if the wrong fabric is used. Fabric choice plays a major role in how a garment feels and performs.

What Should You Consider Before Choosing a Fabric?

Before selecting a fabric, ask yourself:

  • What is the occasion?

  • What season will you wear it in?

  • Do you want a formal or casual look?

  • How often will you wear it?

  • What level of maintenance are you comfortable with?

Your answers will help determine the most suitable fabric.

Which Fabric Is Best for Suits?

Wool – The All-Round Champion

Wool remains the most popular fabric for suits because it is breathable, durable, wrinkle-resistant, and suitable for most climates. It drapes beautifully and maintains its shape exceptionally well.

Best for:

  • Business suits

  • Wedding suits

  • Formal occasions

  • Year-round wear

Linen – Perfect for Summer

Linen is lightweight, breathable, and ideal for hot weather. It keeps you cool and comfortable but naturally wrinkles more than other fabrics.

Best for:

  • Summer weddings

  • Destination weddings

  • Casual formal events

  • Outdoor celebrations

Cotton – Comfortable and Versatile

Cotton offers a clean and relaxed appearance. It is breathable and comfortable, making it a popular choice for semi-formal and everyday wear.

Best for:

  • Casual blazers

  • Business casual outfits

  • Summer clothing

  • Daily wear

Which Fabric Is Best for Shirts?

For custom shirts, the most popular fabrics include:

Cotton

Cotton shirts are soft, breathable, and comfortable throughout the day.

Egyptian Cotton

Known for its luxurious feel and durability, Egyptian cotton is ideal for premium formal shirts.

Cotton Blends

These fabrics offer wrinkle resistance while maintaining comfort.

Which Fabric Is Best for Kurta Pajama?

For ethnic wear and festive outfits, popular choices include:

  • Cotton for everyday comfort

  • Silk for festive occasions

  • Linen for summer celebrations

  • Cotton-silk blends for a premium appearance

The right fabric can significantly enhance the elegance of traditional outfits.

How Does Fabric Change the Fit of a Garment?

Many people don't realize that fabric affects how a garment falls on the body.

  • Wool creates a structured, elegant drape.

  • Linen offers a relaxed appearance.

  • Cotton provides a balanced shape.

  • Silk creates a softer, luxurious flow.

The same design can look completely different depending on the fabric chosen.

Which Fabric Should You Choose for Different Seasons?

Summer

Choose lightweight and breathable fabrics:

  • Linen

  • Cotton

  • Lightweight cotton blends

Winter

Opt for warmer fabrics:

  • Wool

  • Tweed

  • Flannel

All-Season Wear

The safest options include:

  • Wool blends

  • Mid-weight wool

  • Premium cotton blends

These fabrics provide year-round comfort and versatility.

What Fabric Should You Choose for Weddings?

Wedding outfits require fabrics that look luxurious while remaining comfortable.

Recommended options:

  • Premium Wool

  • Silk Blends

  • Velvet (for winter weddings)

  • Linen-Wool Blends (for destination weddings)

The ideal choice depends on the venue, season, and event type.

How Can You Identify a Good Quality Fabric?

Look for these signs:

✔ Soft and smooth texture

✔ Strong weave construction

✔ Good breathability

✔ Natural drape

✔ Minimal pilling

✔ Comfortable feel against the skin

High-quality fabrics not only look better but also last longer.

Why Choose Professional Fabric Consultation?

Selecting fabrics online or from a store can be confusing because hundreds of options are available.

Professional fabric consultation helps you:

  • Choose the right fabric for your purpose

  • Match fabrics to your budget

  • Understand fabric performance

  • Select suitable colors and patterns

  • Avoid costly mistakes

Expert guidance ensures you get the best value from your custom garment.

Need Help Choosing the Right Fabric?

At Call My Tailor, we don't just stitch clothes—we help you choose the perfect fabric for your lifestyle, occasion, and budget.

Our tailoring experts visit your home, show fabric samples, explain the differences between materials, take accurate measurements, and create garments that fit perfectly.

Whether you need a business suit, wedding sherwani, custom shirt, blazer, or kurta pajama, we'll help you select a fabric that looks great and feels even better.

Choose the Right Fabric. Create the Perfect Outfit.

  • Legal compliance

Terms & Conditions

2. Services Offered

CallmyTailor provides various tailoring solutions including custom stitching, ladies tailoring, men's tailoring, blouse stitching, suit stitching, kurta stitching, dress alterations, repairs, and doorstep pickup & delivery services.

3. Orders & Confirmation

  • An order is confirmed only after customer approval and applicable advance payment.
  • Customers must verify measurements, fabric details, designs, and customization requirements before confirming an order.
  • The final approved order details will be considered the official reference in case of any disagreement.

4. Pricing & Payments

  • The amount mentioned on the final invoice shall be considered the final payable amount.
  • A minimum 50% advance payment may be required to confirm a tailoring order.
  • The remaining payment must be completed before or at the time of delivery.
  • Additional charges may apply for urgent stitching, premium customization, or special requests.

5. Pickup, Delivery & Consultation Charges

  • Free pickup and delivery may be available based on minimum order value and service location.
  • Convenience charges may apply for locations or orders that do not meet eligibility requirements.
  • A consultation or visit charge may be applicable if a tailor visits your location and no order is placed.

6. Delivery Timeline

Standard delivery time depends upon garment type, design complexity, fabric availability, and order quantity. Rush orders may be accepted depending on availability and additional charges may apply.

7. Order Modification & Cancellation

  • Order changes should be requested within 24 hours of confirmation and are subject to feasibility.
  • Once cutting, stitching, or production has started, the order may not be cancelled.
  • Eligible cancellations may include applicable processing or service charges.

8. Quality Assurance & Alteration Policy

At CallmyTailor, we are committed to providing premium quality custom tailoring, professional stitching, and perfect garment finishing. Every garment is carefully crafted according to the measurements, design preferences, and instructions provided by the customer.

  • Minor variations in fabric color, texture, or pattern placement may occur due to lighting conditions, screen settings, or natural fabric characteristics.
  • Since every garment is specially customized, products are generally not eligible for return or refund.
  • If any fitting issue or defect occurs due to an error by our tailoring team, CallmyTailor may provide a suitable alteration, repair, or replacement at no additional cost.
  • Alteration requests caused by changes in customer preference or incorrect measurements provided by the customer may require additional charges.
  • Customers may be required to return or make the garment available for inspection before any alteration or quality claim is approved.
Quality Commitment: Our expert tailors aim to deliver comfortable fitting, high-quality stitching, and premium finishing for every custom-made garment.

9. Customer Fabric Responsibility

Customers who provide their own fabric for custom stitching or designer garment creation are responsible for ensuring that the material is suitable and sufficient for the requested garment.

  • CallmyTailor reserves the right to decline an order if the supplied fabric is damaged, defective, insufficient, or unsuitable for stitching.
  • We are not responsible for issues resulting from poor fabric quality, hidden defects, or damage caused during normal stitching where the material itself is the reason.
  • Customers are encouraged to discuss fabric requirements with our tailoring consultant before confirming their order.

10. Delivery, Pickup & Collection Policy

CallmyTailor provides convenient doorstep pickup and delivery services for custom tailoring, alteration services, and garment stitching based on service availability.

  • All pending payments must be completed before the final delivery of the garment.
  • Estimated delivery timelines may change due to fabric availability, design complexity, order volume, holidays, or circumstances beyond our control.
  • Customers should collect or receive their completed garments within a reasonable period after receiving notification from CallmyTailor.
  • If garments remain unclaimed for an extended period and we are unable to contact the customer, CallmyTailor reserves the right to take appropriate action regarding storage or disposal after reasonable notice.
  • CallmyTailor is not responsible for delays caused by incorrect address details, unavailable recipients, or other circumstances beyond our reasonable control.

11. Gift Voucher Policy

If CallmyTailor provides gift vouchers, promotional coupons, or discount codes, the following terms shall apply:

  • Gift vouchers and promotional codes can only be used according to their specific terms and validity period.
  • Vouchers cannot be exchanged for cash, transferred for monetary value, or refunded.
  • CallmyTailor reserves the right to modify, suspend, or cancel any promotional offer at its sole discretion.

12. Limitation of Liability

CallmyTailor makes every reasonable effort to provide reliable online tailor services, doorstep tailoring, garment alteration, and customized stitching solutions.

  • We shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from the use of our services.
  • Our maximum liability, where applicable under law, shall be limited to the value of the specific order or service purchased.
  • Customers are responsible for providing accurate information, measurements, design references, and delivery details.

13. Force Majeure

CallmyTailor shall not be held responsible for any delay, interruption, or failure to perform services due to circumstances beyond our reasonable control.

These circumstances may include natural disasters, extreme weather, government restrictions, strikes, transportation failures, public emergencies, pandemics, technical failures, or other unforeseen events.

14. Updates to Terms & Conditions

CallmyTailor reserves the right to revise, update, or modify these Terms & Conditions at any time without prior notice.

The latest version published on our official website will be considered effective, and continued use of our services indicates your acceptance of any updated terms.

Need Assistance? For any questions regarding our terms, orders, custom stitching, alteration services, or doorstep tailoring solutions, you can contact CallmyTailor through our phone, WhatsApp, or email support.

15. Privacy Policy Overview

CallmyTailor respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you use our website and online tailoring services.

16. Information We Collect

  • Name, phone number, email address, and contact details
  • Delivery address and location information
  • Body measurements and tailoring preferences
  • Order history and service interactions
  • Payment and transaction details (processed securely via third-party providers)

17. How We Use Your Information

  • To process custom tailoring and stitching orders
  • To arrange pickup and doorstep delivery services
  • To communicate order updates and confirmations
  • To provide customer support and service assistance
  • To improve our tailoring services and customer experience
  • To send promotional offers or updates (only if permitted)

  • Delivery and logistics partners

19. Data Security

html:
Order Place & Cancellation﻿

  1. The amount mentioned on the invoice will be considered the final payable amount and non-negotiable. The estimated cost may vary.
  2. The customer must check the order form and confirm all the details are correct at the time the order is placed. If any dispute between the customer and callmytailor over the details of the order, the details on the original order form are taken as the final order.
  3. A minimum order amount of 2,500 is required for free pickup and delivery in Delhi, If the minimum order is not met then a convenience charge of a minimum of 250 INR is levied depending on the area.
  4. If a consultant visits you for booking and you decide not to place an order with us, then a visiting charge of Rs. 250/hour plus government taxes applicable would be payable by you.
  5. It is understood that an order once finalized and confirmed, cannot be canceled upon the commencement of the manufacturing process.  In case the order has been canceled, there will be Rs. 500 deduction from the total value
  6. Any changes must be made to an order within 24 hours of the order confirmation. Making a change within 24 hours of placing the order does not guarantee that a change can be made.
